Engineering

Vận Hành Tải Thấp

Operating main engines or generators at reduced output, often during harbor stay or maneuvering, requiring special monitoring to prevent issues like incomplete combustion.

In this glossary, Vận Hành Tải Thấp refers to: Operating main engines or generators at reduced output, often during harbor stay or maneuvering, requiring special monitoring to prevent issues like incomplete combustion.

How is Vận Hành Tải Thấp used in maritime?

Definition

Operating main engines or generators at reduced output, often during harbor stay or maneuvering, requiring special monitoring to prevent issues like incomplete combustion.

Operational example

Chief engineer, maintain strict watch during low load operation to prevent carbon buildup and inform the bridge of any irregularities.
